name: External browser read DOM
description: Reads text or HTML from the temporary Peer-managed Chromium DOM. Full content is stored as a local artifact.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 读取临时 Peer 托管 Chromium 的文本或 HTML；完整内容落本地 artifact。
localizedDescription.en-US: Reads text or HTML from the temporary Peer-managed Chromium DOM. Full content is stored as a local artifact.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope extraction. Supports frame:N prefix.
